name: Glitch type

source.description: An inspected reel shows a technical word with RGB channel split and slice displacement.

technique: A word flickers with colour-channel offsets and horizontal slice shifts for a few frames, signalling code, error or digital noise.
purpose: Digital or error theme accent in kinetic typography.
visual_behaviour: Red and cyan copies offset by a few pixels; horizontal bands jump sideways for 2-6 frames; snaps clean.
mechanics: Two tinted copies with mix-blend-mode screen/multiply and stepped x offsets; clip-path bands of a clone with stepped x; seeded so it repeats identically.

requirements: per-channel image offsets of video glitches
capability.approximation: Two tinted DOM copies plus stepped band clips; no real compression artefacts.

provenance.observed: A short word card shows channel split and scanline offsets.
